claims.body: Resize queue depth spikes past ten thousand during burst uploads
Each upload enqueues one resize job per preset with no coalescing

probes.rationale: Tier-1 drafts are invisible to the push path (DESIGN.md 4, draft-nudge review): a machine-derived likely_root_cause with evidence refs at the 0.5 cap is neither injected nor pointed at — it lends no word to the floor and is no claim of its tree until its author confirms it; the pull (get_diagnosis, search) still shows it.
